tool.description: Execute a deployed Apps Script function with JSON parameters. Enabling this exact account-level tool with destructive permission authorizes arbitrary script effects across the selected Google account within ALL scopes of that connection; selected-file grants do NOT sandbox script code. Chat additionally requires one-use exact-argument write approval. Tokens carrying BigQuery scope are rejected because arbitrary scripts cannot enforce max-bytes-billed. Requires an API-executable deployment, same standard Cloud project as the OAuth client, enabled Apps Script API and all scopes required by the entire script. Use deployment ID, not project ID; development/HEAD mode is not exposed.
tool.name: appscript_run

parent_tab.description: Optional parent tab title or ID; empty or omitted places the tab at the root.

title.description: Optional literal tab title; empty or omitted auto-titles the tab.

tool.description: Replace named-range content with literal inline plain text in one explicitly granted document, optionally scoped to a tab. tool.description: Insert nonempty literal plain text at a UTF-16 index, a literal anchor or native append position in one selected document/tab/segment. Header/footer/footnote indexes may start at zero. Preserves native ambiguity and revision checks; exact write-tool/file authority and one-use chat approval. No files/stdin/markdown/persisted batch or automatic retries.
tool.name: docs_insert

tool.description: Delete a UTF-16 start/end range or a literal anchored range in one selected document/tab/segment. Exact write-tool/file and destructive authority required, plus one-use chat approval. Preserves ambiguity/revision checks and native final-newline handling; no file/batch inputs or automatic retries.
tool.name: docs_delete

tool.description: Clear the native default document body while preserving its final newline and other tabs/headers/footers. No tab selector is exposed because native clear targets the legacy/default body. Exact write-tool/file and destructive authority required; chat uses one-use approval. Single-attempt typed request; no arbitrary sed expressions.
tool.name: docs_clear

tool.description: Replace literal text with literal inline plain text, all matches by default or first only, optionally on a selected tab. Preserves native case/tab behavior; exact write-tool/file grants and chat one-use approval. Empty replacement additionally requires destructive authority. No markdown, files, stdin or automatic retries; native replace-all does not provide a revision precondition, first-only does.

tool.description: Format native document text/paragraphs, first/all literal matches or default whole body, optionally on a tab/header/footer/footnote. Boolean false clears bold/italic/underline/strike; paragraph pointer booleans and zero spacing/indents are preserved. Empty link clears it; links are set, not fetched. Native style/conflict validation retained. Exact document/tool write grants and one-use chat approval; no files/raw masks/batches or automatic retries.

tool.description: Set native paged/pageless layout, named/custom size or margins on an exact document/tab. Dimension strings accept pt/in/cm/mm including zero margins. Margin-only updates preserve existing mode; with no fields native default is pageless. Exact write-tool/document grants and one-use chat approval; no wildcard/raw requests or automatic retries.
tool.name: docs_page_layout

tool.description: Set one-to-three columns and none/between separator at a UTF-16 index, literal anchor or native end position in one document/tab. tool.description: Write to Google Slides (write/slides tool grant): replace text via gog slides replace-text. Exactly one mode is required: all slides (--all), specific page IDs (--page), or a single object (--object). An empty replacement deletes matching text and additionally requires the destructive permission; the runner enforces this.

all.description: Replace in every slide. Mutually exclusive with page_ids and object_id.

find.description: Text to find. Must be non-empty; spaces are valid.

object_id.description: Single object ID to restrict the replacement to. Mutually exclusive with all and page_ids.

page_ids.description: Page IDs to restrict the replacement to. Mutually exclusive with all and object_id.

replacement.description: Replacement text. May be empty to delete matching text (requires destructive permission).

tool.name: slides_replace_text
